- **🧑‍🏫"},{"id":"p14s3","text":" gaps button** — in the session header action row, shows a due-count badge
and opens the gap panel.
"},{"id":"p14s4","text":"- **Gap panel** — floating overlay listing this session's gaps (kind, topic,

`/retest`.
- **📝 quiz popup** — the **LLM-free quiz**: questions come fro"},{"id":"p14s7","text":"m the `teacherQuiz`
session projection (loaded from the SQLite store, no AI involved); each

box, with a 💡 hint toggle. F"},{"id":"p14s9","text":"inish submits your answers to the plugin

h"},{"id":"p14s11","text":"eader button or `/quiz`."},{"id":"p15s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"Requires DSH rc.6+ and Node ≥ 22.5 (uses built-in `node:sqlite`)."},{"id":"p17s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"## Usage"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"| Command | What it does |"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"| `/teach questions.md` | Load the question set into the SQLite store and enter teacher mode (**does"},{"id":"p21s2","text":" not start teaching** — say "start", "quiz me", or ask about a topic) |
| `/teach on` / `/teach off`"},{"id":"p21s3","text":" | Toggle teacher mode (mode is session state, survives resume) |
| `/quiz` | Open the **LLM-free qu"},{"id":"p21s4","text":"iz popup** over the whole bank (MCQ / free-text); finishing it hands the results to the teacher's LL"},{"id":"p21s5","text":"M analysis and the Socratic walk over the misses |
| `/gaps` | Show the gap ledger for this course |"},{"id":"p21s6","text":"
| `/retest` | Surface due gaps for an on-demand drill (FSRS-5 schedule) |
| `/summary` | End-of-ses"},{"id":"p21s7","text":"sion knowledge-gap & misconception summary |"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"### Teacher behavior (model tools)"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"- **`next_question`** — pulls one question at a time; the answer key never appears in tool output.

- **`analyze_quiz`*"},{"id":"p23s7","text":"* — post-quiz LLM analysis: pass the run id from the popup ("Quiz finished (run N)"), get the run's "},{"id":"p23s8","text":"questions (hidden answer keys + hints) and the user's answers, grade each (correct/partial/wrong/no-"},{"id":"p23s9","text":"answer), record gaps, and walk the misses Socratically; `done: true` marks the run analyzed.

- **`grade_answer`** —"},{"id":"p23s12","text":" grades against the hidden answer key; updates each open gap's FSRS schedule; `correct` marks gaps m"},{"id":"p23s13","text":"astered.

- **`summ"},{"id":"p23s14","text":"ary`** — pulls the ledger for the end-of-session knowledge-point report."},{"id":"p24s1","text":"Per the policy section (injected only while teacher mode is active): hard Socratic
